inventory.instructions: Choose A18 inventory method that supports reviewable complete coverage without inventing evidence levels.

criteria.freeze_source_units_then_classify: Freeze exact current document bytes, number every narrative/bullet/table claim candidate, and preserve a source-to-candidate coverage map; classify separately with actual artifacts

levels.instructions: Historical internal study reports and saved receipts do not provide a new externally dated public prospective commitment or independent replication. How should current levels be assigned?

criteria.artifact_bound_conservative_levels: Choose L0-L2 only when actual complete evidence supports each scope; separate missing raw data and untested T0 implementation; no invented timestamp or independence
criteria.declare_prospective_support: Declare L3 or higher from internal summaries alone
